## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:backend`
- [ ] `npm run chain:test` (when contract behavior changes)

## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files are included.
- [ ] Database migration impact is described (if applicable).
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording are included for UI changes.
- [ ] Meter, payment, delivery, and climate claims are appropriately qualified.
